title: Embedding of retained layer-one gates
statement: Let $C$ be a depth circuit and let $w$ be a natural number. The layer-one gates of $C$ whose terms have width at most $w$ form a finite set of indices. The definition gives an injective map from an ordinal whose size is the number of these indices into the ordinal indexing all layer-one gates, with image exactly the set of retained indices.
